terms.short: a common type of breast cancer
terms.definition: Cancer that started in a milk duct and has grown into nearby breast tissue.
Cancer that started in the milk-producing lobules and has spread into nearby tissue.
A cancer that forms in mucus-secreting gland cells.
The edges of the tissue removed during surgery; negative margins mean no cancer was seen at the edge.

terms.short: small filters in the immune system
terms.definition: Small structures that help the body fight infection; cancer can spread to them.
A code for tumor size/extent (T), lymph nodes (N), and distant metastasis (M) based on pathology.
A test that checks whether cancer cells have too much of a protein that can drive growth.
A test showing whether cancer cells use estrogen to grow.
A test showing whether cancer cells use progesterone to grow.
A test of how well cancer cells repair certain DNA mistakes.
